    15→## Reference Example Project
    16→
    17→This skill includes a complete example project from https://github.com/siarhei-luskanau/compose-multiplatform-template in the `examples/` directory. **Always refer to these files as the canonical reference** when generating code or advising on architecture:
    18→
    19→### Gradle & Build Configuration

    54→- `examples/platform-entry-points/DesktopMain.kt` — Desktop (Window + application)

    61→
    62→**When generating new code, match the style, naming, and patterns from these examples exactly.**
    63→
    64→---
    65→
    66→## Architecture Principles
    67→
    68→### Gradle Multimodule Structure
    69→
    70→Always organize projects with clear module boundaries:
    71→
    72→```
    73→app/                    # Platform entry points (thin shells)
    74→  androidApp/           # Android app module (Activity + KoinApp)
    75→  desktopApp/           # Desktop app module (Window + KoinApp)
    76→  webApp/               # Web app module (ComposeViewport + KoinApp)
    77→composeApp/             # Shared Compose application (main app composable)
    78→core/                   # Core business logic
    79→  coreCommon/           # Platform services, dispatchers, utilities
    80→  corePref/             # Preferences/DataStore management
    81→navigation/             # Navigation setup (Jetpack Navigation3)
    82→ui/                     # UI feature modules
    83→  uiCommon/             # Shared theme, resources, common components
    84→  uiMain/               # Feature: main screen
    85→  uiSplash/             # Feature: splash screen
    86→convention-plugin-multiplatform/  # Custom Gradle convention plugins
    87→```
    88→
    89→**Key rules:**
    90→- Platform app modules are thin shells — they only call `KoinApp()` composable
    91→- Each feature gets its own `ui/ui*` module
    92→- Core logic lives in `core/` modules, independent of UI
    93→- Navigation is a standalone module implementing all navigation callbacks
    94→- Convention plugins centralize all KMP build configuration
    95→
    96→### Convention Plugin Pattern
    97→
    98→Use precompiled script plugins in `convention-plugin-multiplatform/` to avoid repeating KMP configuration:
    99→
   100→```kotlin
   101→// convention-plugin-multiplatform/src/main/kotlin/composeMultiplatformConvention.gradle.kts
   102→plugins {
   103→    id("org.jetbrains.kotlin.multiplatform")
   104→    id("org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose")
   105→    id("org.jetbrains.compose")
   106→    id("com.android.library")
   107→}
   108→
   109→kotlin {
   110→    androidTarget()
   111→    jvm()
   112→    js(IR) { browser() }
   113→    wasmJs { browser() }
   114→    listOf(iosArm64(), iosSimulatorArm64()).forEach {
   115→        it.binaries.framework { baseName = project.name; isStatic = true }
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    sourceSets {
   119→        commonMain.dependencies {
   120→            // shared dependencies
   121→        }
   122→    }
   123→}
   124→```
   125→
   126→Then every module simply applies:
   127→```kotlin
   128→plugins {
   129→    id("composeMultiplatformConvention")
   130→}
   131→```
   132→
   133→**Version catalog access in convention plugins** — use this pattern:
   134→```kotlin
   135→// convention-plugin-multiplatform/build.gradle.kts
   136→dependencies {
   137→    implementation(files(libs.javaClass.superclass.protectionDomain.codeSource.location))
   138→}
   139→```
   140→
   141→### Dependency Management
   142→
   143→- Use **Gradle Version Catalog** (`gradle/libs.versions.toml`) for all dependency versions
   144→- Use **type-safe project accessors** (`TYPESAFE_PROJECT_ACCESSORS` in settings):
   145→  ```kotlin
   146→  implementation(projects.core.coreCommon)
   147→  implementation(projects.ui.uiCommon)
   148→  ```
   149→- Use **Koin BOM** for consistent DI versions:
   150→  ```kotlin
   151→  implementation(project.dependencies.platform(libs.koin.bom))
   152→  ```
   153→
   154→### Source Set Structure
   155→
   156→Every KMP module follows this consistent layout:
   157→```
   158→src/
   159→  commonMain/kotlin/       # Shared code (majority of code lives here)
   160→  commonTest/kotlin/       # Shared tests
   161→  androidMain/kotlin/      # Android-specific (expect/actual implementations)
   162→  androidHostTest/kotlin/  # Android Robolectric/screenshot tests
   163→  jvmMain/kotlin/          # Desktop-specific
   164→  jvmTest/kotlin/          # Desktop tests
   165→  iosMain/kotlin/          # iOS-specific
   166→  iosTest/kotlin/          # iOS tests
   167→  webMain/kotlin/          # Web-specific (JS + Wasm shared)
   168→```
   169→
   170→---
   171→
   172→## Core Patterns
   173→
   174→### Expect/Actual
   175→
   176→Use expect/actual for platform-specific implementations:
   177→
   178→**Pattern 1 — Koin DI Modules:**
   179→```kotlin
   180→// commonMain
   181→expect val corePrefModule: Module
   182→
   183→// androidMain
   184→actual val corePrefModule = module {
   185→    single { createDataStore(get<Context>()) }
   186→}
   187→
   188→// jvmMain
   189→actual val corePrefModule = module {
   190→    single { createDataStore() }
   191→}
   192→```
   193→
   194→**Pattern 2 — Platform Services:**
   195→```kotlin
   196→// commonMain - define interface
   197→interface PlatformService { ... }
   198→
   199→// Platform-specific implementations in androidMain, jvmMain, iosMain, webMain
   200→```
   201→
   202→**Pattern 3 — Coroutine Dispatchers:**
   203→```kotlin
   204→// commonMain
   205→interface DispatcherSet {
   206→    val default: CoroutineDispatcher
   207→    val io: CoroutineDispatcher
   208→    val main: CoroutineDispatcher
   209→}
   210→// Each platform provides actual dispatcher implementations
   211→```
   212→
   213→### MVVM Architecture per Feature
   214→
   215→Every UI feature module follows this structure:
   216→```
   217→ui/uiFeature/
   218→  src/commonMain/kotlin/
   219→    FeatureScreen.kt           # Composable UI (stateful + stateless)
   220→    FeatureViewModel.kt        # State management + business logic
   221→    FeatureViewState.kt        # Sealed class: Loading / Success / Error
   222→    FeatureViewEvent.kt        # User interaction events
   223→    FeatureNavigationCallback.kt  # Navigation actions interface
   224→    FeaturePreviewData.kt      # Preview composables for testing
   225→```
   226→
   227→**ViewModel pattern:**
   228→```kotlin
   229→class FeatureViewModel(
   230→    private val navigationCallback: FeatureNavigationCallback,
   231→) : ViewModel() {
   232→    val viewState: StateFlow<FeatureViewState>
   233→        field = MutableStateFlow<FeatureViewState>(FeatureViewState.Loading)
   234→
   235→    fun onEvent(event: FeatureViewEvent) { ... }
   236→}
   237→```
   238→
   239→**Screen pattern — separate stateful and stateless:**
   240→```kotlin
   241→@Composable
   242→fun FeatureScreen(viewModel: FeatureViewModel) {
   243→    val viewState by viewModel.viewState.collectAsState()
   244→    FeatureScreenContent(viewState = viewState, onEvent = viewModel::onEvent)
   245→}
   246→
   247→@Composable
   248→fun FeatureScreenContent(viewState: FeatureViewState, onEvent: (FeatureViewEvent) -> Unit) {
   249→    // Pure UI, no side effects — easy to preview and test
   250→}
   251→```
   252→
   253→### Dependency Injection with Koin
   254→
   255→- Each module defines its own Koin module
   256→- Platform-specific modules provide platform dependencies
   257→- ViewModels created via factory with parameters:
   258→  ```kotlin
   259→  factory { params -> FeatureViewModel(navigationCallback = params[0]) }
   260→  ```
   261→
   262→### Navigation with Jetpack Navigation3
   263→
   264→- Type-safe routes using `@Serializable` data objects/classes
   265→- Backstack managed with `mutableStateListOf<NavKey>`
   266→- Central `AppNavigation` class implements all feature navigation callbacks
   267→- Navigation module depends on all feature modules
   268→
   269→---
   270→
   271→## Testing Strategy
   272→
   273→### Screenshot Testing with Roborazzi
   274→
   275→- Integrated across modules for visual regression testing
   276→- Platform-specific screenshot tests: Android (Robolectric), Desktop, iOS
   277→- Screenshots stored in `src/screenshots/` per module
   278→- Run with `-DIS_DATA_STUB_ENABLED=true` for deterministic output

   343→
   344→## When Advising on KMP Projects
   345→
   346→1. **Always maximize shared code in `commonMain`** — platform-specific code should be minimal
   347→2. **Use convention plugins** — never duplicate build configuration across modules
   348→3. **One feature = one module** — keeps build times low and separation clean
   349→4. **App modules are thin shells** — all logic lives in shared modules
   350→5. **Prefer interfaces in commonMain** with platform implementations via expect/actual or DI
   351→6. **Version catalog for everything** — no hardcoded versions in build files
   352→7. **Screenshot tests for every screen** — catch visual regressions automatically
   353→8. **Type-safe navigation** — use serializable routes, not string-based navigation
   354→9. **Stateless composables** — separate state management from UI rendering for testability
   355→10. **DataStore over SharedPreferences** — multiplatform-compatible preferences
